items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: They had Buck Vanville's band there for years.

ctx.x: By the overpass. They moved up in there. Though we used to be right there at Claiborne and Music. Yeah, Claiborne and Music. That's the one I used to do.
Yeah. They had Buck Vanville's band there for years. Yeah. The Philly Red. You remember Philly Red? Yeah. You remember Philly Red? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
